notes.title: Important Update on BUSTAFELLOWS save data issue
notes.notes:
[h2][b]⚠️ Important Update Regarding Save Data ⚠️[/b][/h2][p][/p][p]We have identified an issue that may cause save data loss for some players.[/p][p][/p][p]To protect your progress, this is a [b]mandatory update for ALL players[/b], not just those currently affected.[/p][p][/p][p][b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Do [b]NOT[/b] launch BUSTAFELLOWS until you have carefully completed Steps 1–3! [/p][p][/p][p][b]Step 1:[/b] Update the game to the latest Update[/p][p][/p][p][b]Step 2:[/b] While logged in to Steam from a PC browser, access the following URL and download the save data. [/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/account/remotestorage"]https://store.steampowered.com/account/remotestorage[/url][/p][p][/p][p][b]Step 3:[/b] In the Steam client app, right-click on the title “BUSTAFELLOWS”, then select Manage > Browse Local Files. This will open the installation folder for “BUSTAFELLOWS.” [/p][p]Inside the folder “BUSTAFELLOWS_Data\\StreamingAssets”, paste the file you just downloaded.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/613a6e83f001d25516b8eda144c6ddf632911a87.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Once steps 1–3 are complete, you can safely launch the game![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for updating and enjoy BUSTAFELLOWS ✨[/p][p]
Please note: This update cannot recover save data that has already been lost or overwritten. We sincerely apologise for any inconvenience this may have caused.[/p][p]
[/p]

notes.title: Pending Resolution: Save Data Issue
notes.notes:
[p]Hello players,

We are aware of reports regarding save data loss following the update on 8 August 2025.[/p][p]While the investigation into the cause is still ongoing, we strongly recommend backing up your local save data from the following path:[/p][p] [/p][p]The drive where the game is installed -[/p][p]\\SteamLibrary\\steamapps\\common\\BUSTAFELLOWS\\BUSTAFELLOWS_Data\\StreamingAssets[/p][p] [/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and appreciate your understanding. 🙇🙇[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for your support,[/p][p]The Team at PQube.[/p]

notes.title: BUSTAFELLOWS season2 is coming 17th July 2025
notes.notes:
BUSTAFELLOWS season2 is officially coming on 17th July, 2025!

The hit visual novel, BUSTAFELLOWS returns with an all-new season, bringing back the crime-solving gang you know and love, along with new faces and even bigger stories.

Step into the cinematic world of New Sieg, where every choice you make shapes the story. You will uncover the truths, navigate high-stakes drama, and help decide the fate of those around you. With five different playable movies, each corresponding to a different male lead, you'll experience unique storylines. Utilise the new Flowchart System to track your progress and revisit key moments, ensuring you never miss a crucial decision! 

Continue building your romance and deepening your connection with Limbo, Shu, Helvetica, Mozu, and Scarecrow as you uncover new sides to each of them. Not only will you learn more about the boys but you can experience them in a new light with new outfits, hairstyles and scenarios! Along the way, you'll also meet intriguing new characters like Geuro, Juno, and Watcher, who will add even more depth to your journey.

Are you ready to dive back into the world of crime and romance?

notes.title: Bustafellows is a murder mystery dating sim and overriding my better judgement
notes.notes:
An otome dating visual novel? I've nothing against the genre, but it's not for me.

And yet, and yet, I keep re-watching the launch trailer and reading the Steam page for Bustafellows. Murder mystery? I love those. Puzzles and interactive narrative based in part around a time travel mechanic? Sounds neat. Lush art and a jazzy soundtrack? I'm all over it.

I definitely want the game these words make me imagine, but I've been duped before. Check out the trailer below and tell me I'm wrong.

Read more

notes.title: Exclusive developer interview for Bustafellows!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/f9f8f0e7ef7ac3b8238ff67602a28c9131c7ed35.jpg[/img]

We have an exclusive interview up now over with our friends at Siliconera. The interview comes directly from the developers themselves, so if you're looking for some new details, now is your chance!
 
Get a taste of the exclusive interview below and read the rest on Siliconera!
 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/118ecf4f9bdadd4db4b3056f8085903190dfcc27.gif[/img]
 
Q: Each of the lead characters in BUSTAFELLOWS is someone who might be considered a bit shady or intimidating. How did you develop the members of the cast and what was your goal for each love interest?

A: I think about it as, there’s a fictional city, where there are things happening, and people living. If you think too much about making a good-looking character or a unique character, you will end up with them being out of place.

We have nurtured the story and the characters, hoping to make them as real as possible; as if they were alive, as if they really existed, and even more as if they were a part of our daily lives. I don't think "romance" is the goal in their story, nor is it the most important thing. I think that showing their qualities in family, love, friendship, and romance in all of them, is what gives life to the characters.


 [url=https://www.siliconera.com/interview-bustafellows-producer-minetaka-talks-about-developing-the-adventure-game/#utm_source=Steam&utm_medium=Post&utm_campaign=BUST-Interview-Siliconera-Steam style=button]Read the full interview on Siliconera [/url]

[h3][u][b]'New Sieg People Weekly' Magazine[/b][/u][/h3]
Originally launched in Japan only, BUSTAFELLOWS received critical acclaim leading to the highly coveted status of its limited run collector's edition. Now, players in the west will have the opportunity to grab an abridged version of 'New Sieg People Weekly' magazine as featured in the original Japanese collector's edition once again.
 
Featuring original sketches, unique art and character profiles, the magazine has been localised to English and offers an intimate behind the scenes glimpse at the development of BUSTAFELLOWS and its captivating cast of characters.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39398751/c744e368ec5c801512091c883184815c50e4ad57.jpg[/img]
